summary: Coincheck Group N.V. filed a Form 6-K furnishing monthly operational metrics for its subsidiary Coincheck, Inc. for the period July 2025 through June 2026. The filing discloses Exchange Trading Volume, Marketplace Trading Volume, Customer Assets, and Number of Verified Accounts in million yen. No transaction, strategic action, or special situation is presented; it is a routine operational update by a foreign private issuer. This is equivalent to a voluntary current report of business data, not a U.S. special situation filing. No deal terms apply; no board or advisor actions are mentioned.
